# Weekly Market Briefing — November 22, 2026

## 1. Market Regime: Decisively Risk-Off
The macro backdrop is defensive. The yield curve remains normal (10Y-3M at +0.79 pts), but the signal is in volatility: VIX sits at 35.89, up a dramatic +18.58 MoM — a "high fear" regime. The dollar is firm (DXY 103.81, +2.2 MoM), the classic flight-to-safety tell. The 10Y fell to 4.91% (▼0.2% MoM) as money rotated into Treasuries. Broad-market factor readings confirm the defensive tilt: Low-Vol dominates (DIA 73, VOO 66, SPY 64) while Momentum is middling (SPY 46, QQQ 34), and every major index is deeply oversold (SPY/VOO/VTI RSI 25). This is a stressed, de-risking tape — capital favoring stability over beta.

## 2. This Week's News
An AI-led rout drove the action. For the week, the S&P 500 lost 8.6 percent, its worst week since April 2025. The Nasdaq recorded its largest weekly percentage loss since March 2020. The epicenter was Nvidia: Nvidia was at the center of the selloff. The stock lost 22.9% for the week and is down nearly 50% from its October 6 peak, erasing about $2.8 trillion in market value. The dual catalyst was AI-funding anxiety plus rate fears — almost all members of the Federal Reserve favored raising interest rates in the future, even as they decided to hold rates steady in October, according to October minutes released Wednesday. The minutes made a December rate hike look close to certain. Notably, government bonds performed well as a safe haven, with the 10-year Treasury yield on track for its biggest weekly fall since April 2025.

## 3. Factor Leadership: Low-Vol & Value over Momentum
Defensives are being rewarded. Staples screen highest on Low-Vol (XLP 96) and Momentum (XLP 76), with Utilities (XLU 84 Low-Vol), Real Estate (XLRE 91), and Healthcare (XLV 86/89) close behind. This matches the tape — consumer staples were the only sector that rose on Friday. Energy is the standout cyclical (XLE Momentum 82, 12-1Mom +60.5%). Tech is the clear laggard (XLK Momentum 36, Low-Vol 36). Value also shines in defensives/bonds (TLT 100, ABBV 98, XLC 96).

## 4. Notable Movers
- **AMD**: extreme momentum anomaly — Momentum 98, 12-1Mom +150.8%, but Low-Vol just 4 and Vol% 75.
- **NVDA**: top Quality (100) and Growth (96), yet Momentum collapsed to 9, RSI 15 (deeply oversold), -48% from highs.
- **Overbought defensives**: PG (RSI 62), KO (58), XLP (55) — crowded safety trade.
- **Oversold crowd**: CRM (RSI 21), GLD/SLV (24/20), PLTR (26) — even gold sold off.
- **ABBV**: rare quad-threat (Value 98, Momentum 100, Growth 100, Quality 76).
- **Crypto**: broadly weak (BTC Momentum 26, ADA/DOGE single digits).

## 5. Themes to Watch
Next week is shortened, with US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving. The October PCE inflation report is the main data point before the Fed meets December 8-9. Watch whether oversold breadth sparks a reflex bounce, the AI-funding narrative around Nvidia, and whether Treasury's safe-haven bid holds against hawkish Fed rhetoric. With market makers holding negative gamma at every strike, selling into declines and buying into rallies, expect amplified two-way swings.

*This briefing is analytical only; specific positioning calls are reserved for the monthly report.*
